label: Scorch (FTS index storage format)
type: one of two on-disk storage formats a Bleve-based FTS index partition can use, made up of Zap-file snapshots. Mutually exclusive with fts:moss-storage for a given index (the format is chosen per index, not mixed). Platform-restricted: usable on Linux only outside Red Hat-based distributions and Ubuntu.
evidence: Each Scorch index contains a number of snapshots, each of which represents the state of all indexed data at a particular point in time.
Each Scorch-index partition is represented by a Zap file, which is located in the store sub-directory for the partition.
Can be used on a Scorch index partition, but only on platforms other than Red Hat-based distributions and Ubuntu Linux.
note: hasInternalComponent fts:snapshot-epoch; belongsToIndexClass fts:zap-file-format. First contact with the cbft-bleve-* diagnostic-tool family's own storage-internals vocabulary, distinct from the already-promoted search/fts REST and UI index-management vocabulary.
relates_to_competency_question: What are the two on-disk storage formats an FTS index partition can use, and are they interchangeable?
